info.name: OPD Wallet API — web-admin
info.description:
Scoped to the routes \web-admin is seen to call. Recovered by scanning source for request paths, so it is a lower bound: a path assembled at runtime from a variable does not appear here.

Generated from http://localhost:4000/api/docs-json — do not hand-edit, it is overwritten on regeneration.

Auth: httpOnly `opd_session` cookie. Log in via the auth folder first; Postman's cookie jar carries it to every other request.

77 descriptions authored via @ApiOperation, 66 derived from handler names and marked as such.
